setup: Use a fresh disposable offline session or a dedicated live editor document for every attempt. Seed an auto-layout frame with one fill child and one fixed child, two component variants, an instance, a color variable and fixed-size overflowing text. Obtain every ID and current revision from inspection. Never mutate a user's working document for evaluation.
results: Record one JSONL object per attempt. Run scripts/agent_model_eval.py --task <id> for executable tasks. It launches Codex CLI with a private stdio Desigma MCP server and disposable workspace, then scores the saved document structure. Tool-call and token usage come only from Codex JSONL events; unknown counts are omitted.

tasks.prompt: Resize the horizontal auto-layout frame to 320 pixels wide, verify the fill child expands and the fixed child stays fixed, and inspect the rendered result.
assertions: frame width equals 320
padding and gap stay constant
fill child receives remaining content width
get_layout agrees with stored geometry
one undo restores all changed nodes
redo restores the same rendered pixels

tasks.prompt: Switch the existing component instance to the other variant while preserving applicable overrides, inspect it and render it.
assertions: instance points to the requested variant
descendants reflect the target variant
applicable overrides survive
one undo restores the original instance subtree

tasks.prompt: Bind the rectangle's first fill to the existing color variable, then change that variable and verify the effective fill.
assertions: fills/0 binding refers to the existing variable ID
resolved fill follows the selected mode
changing the variable changes rendered color
undo restores both transaction states in order

tasks.prompt: Rename two nodes as one batch. Preview first, then commit and undo once. Try a batch whose second node is missing and confirm there are no partial edits.
assertions: dry run does not change document, revision or history
both renames commit together
one undo restores both
missing node returns missing_node
failure preserves redo and original document

tasks.prompt: Find the overflowing fixed-size text from diagnostics, resize its box so the text fits, then rerun diagnostics and render it.
assertions: diagnostics identify the overflowing text ID before editing
no text_overflow remains for that node after editing
render contains the full content
one undo restores the previous box

tasks.prompt: Read a revision, make a valid change, undo it, then try to write using the originally read revision. Inspect the response and document.
assertions: write returns stale_revision
revision is monotonic across undo
failed write changes neither document nor redo history

tasks.prompt: Discover and attach to the dedicated editor, inspect selection and viewport, apply one batch, undo in the editor, then pause and revoke access using the editor controls.
assertions: live context matches the editor document identity
write is visible in the open editor
one editor undo restores the original
writes while dragging return operation_conflict
paused and revoked access cannot mutate
closed or replacement document is rejected
expired queued writes are not applied later

tasks.prompt: Set the Evaluation target text style to 32 px and weight 700. Inspect the layer and verify the final style before saving.
assertions: Text font size is 32
Text font weight is 700

tasks.prompt: Set the Evaluation target layer's blend mode to Multiply and corner_smoothing to 0.35. Verify both values before saving.
assertions: Blend mode is Multiply
Corner smoothing is 0.35

tasks.prompt: Turn the Evaluation target frame into a main component. Inspect it to confirm its type, then save.
assertions: Target kind is Component

tasks.prompt: Give Evaluation target an OnClick reaction that navigates to Evaluation destination. Verify the reaction and save.
assertions: Target has an OnClick Navigate reaction to destination
